mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost of AEO services for contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AEO services for contractors varies widely based on the scope of work, the competitiveness of the market, and the chosen service provider. Packages can range from a few hundred dollars per month for basic local optimization to several thousand for comprehensive strategies including content creation, technical SEO, reputation management, and advanced link building. Factors influencing cost include the number of services needed, the size of your service area, and the level of ongoing support required to maintain and improve your authoritative presence online.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO service costs for contractors vary significantly, typically ranging from a few hundred to several thousand dollars monthly, depending on scope and market competition.
